text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is a timeless design style.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignStyle(x) ::: x is a design style.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Timeless(zaHaDid, x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) ∨ DesignStyle(kellyWearstler)) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Evocative(kellyWearstler, x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Dreamy(kellyWearstler, x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
Timeless(max, y) → (MassProduct(max, y) ∧ Evocative(max, y)) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(max, y) ∧ Dreamy(max, y) ::: A design by Max is evocative and dreamy.
